column2: .) Origin of data Migration statistics is compiled by Statistics Austria and is based on the data (registrations and deregistrations) of the ZMR (central register of residents). Migrations within Austria (internal migrations) are changes of main residence within Austria. Apart from cross-border migrations (across the adiministrative borders of province, district or commune) changes of main residence within the same commune are covered by migration statistics. Other Metadata: https://www.statistik.at/fileadmin/pages/431/Standard_Dokumentation_Wanderungsstatistik_ab_2002.pdf For further information please see Other Metadata: https://www.statistik.at/en/statistics/population-and-society/population/migration-and-naturalisation .) Legal foundations Migration statistics is a statutory statistics according to article 4(1) Federal Statistics Law. The transfer of the register data required for migration statistics is regulated by article 16b(6) of the registration law. .)
